concerns.text: Critical data-flow violation: T023 (Distillation Loop) depends on T022-VALIDATE (Filtered Dataset), which depends on T022-TRACE (Trace Entropy), which depends on T020-TEACHER (Probability Distributions). T020-TEACHER is marked incomplete/unimplemented. The pipeline cannot execute the distillation phase because the producer (T020-TEACHER) of the required artifact (token probabilities) is missing, blocking all downstream consumer tasks (T022, T023).

Dead-end dependency: T013 (Generate Generalization Set) and T044 (Distinctness Verification) are marked as needing implementation but were previously rejected for missing artifacts. T013-VERIFY depends on the successful generation of T013. Without a concrete, verifiable implementation plan for T013/T044, the 'Generalization Set' artifact cannot be produced, blocking T029 (Evaluation) which requires this specific input.

Missing producer for valid data: T014 (Contradiction Detection) is required to ensure the generator produces solvable problems (FR-001). Without T014, the generator may produce unsolvable problems, corrupting the input for T020-TEACHER (Trace Generation) and T023 (Distillation). T014 is currently unimplemented, creating a risk of invalid data flowing into the pipeline.

Incorrect ordering of critical validation: T061 (CPU-Only Enforcement) and T064 (Trace Probability Validation) are placed in 'Post-Analysis Resolution' (Phase N+3). These are fundamental architectural constraints required for the core pipeline (Phase 4) to function correctly. Deferring them to a post-analysis phase means the core distillation tasks (T023) could run with invalid assumptions (GPU usage, unnormalized probabilities) before these checks are ever implemented.

False completion status: T017 (Checksum Recording) is marked [X] (complete), but it depends on T013 and T044 (Generation/Validation) which are unimplemented/rejected. A checksum cannot be recorded for files that do not exist. This creates a semantic ordering error where a consumer task is marked complete before its producer tasks are viable.
